description: Declarative validation tests with Zod to prevent invalid data

tests.name: Reject negative mana_cost
tests.description: A skill with a negative mana_cost must be rejected

errors.message: Number must be greater than or equal to 0

tests.aiRecoveryHint: The 'mana_cost' field must be a positive number (>= 0). Skills cannot have a negative mana cost.

tests.name: Reject invalid rarity
tests.description: A character with rarity greater than 5 must be rejected

errors.message: Number must be less than or equal to 5

tests.aiRecoveryHint: Rarity must be between 3 (rare) and 5 (legendary). There are no rarities above 5 in this system.

tests.name: Reject invalid element
tests.description: A character with element 'darkness' must be rejected

errors.message: Invalid element. Options: pyro, hydro, electro, cryo, anemo, geo, dendro

tests.aiRecoveryHint: The valid elements are: pyro (fire), hydro (water), electro (lightning), cryo (ice), anemo (wind), geo (earth), dendro (nature).

tests.name: Reject slug with uppercase letters
tests.description: A slug with uppercase letters must be rejected

errors.message: Slug can only contain lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens

tests.aiRecoveryHint: The slug must be lowercase, without spaces, using only hyphens (-) as separators. Example: 'test-character-123'

tests.name: Transactional batch - Rollback
tests.description: If one operation of the batch fails, all of them must roll back

error.message: Validation failed: mana_cost: Number must be >= 0

tests.note: The character 'Hero' must NOT be created because the batch rolls back

tests.name: Conditional if/then validation
tests.description: If element is pyro, weapon_type cannot be bow
tests.aiRecoveryHint: Pyro characters cannot use bows according to the game rules. Valid options: sword, claymore, polearm, catalyst.

tests.name: Circular reference validation
tests.description: Circular references in @ref must not be allowed
tests.note: An alias defined in the same operation cannot be referenced

tests.name: Accept valid data
tests.description: A fully valid character must pass

tests.name: Reject empty name
tests.description: A character without a name must be rejected

errors.message: String must contain at least 1 character(s)

tests.aiRecoveryHint: The character's name is required and must have at least 1 character.

tests.name: Reject excessive cooldown
tests.description: A skill with cooldown > 3600 seconds must be rejected

errors.message: Number must be less than or equal to 3600

tests.aiRecoveryHint: The maximum allowed cooldown is 3600 seconds (1 hour). Consider using a different charge system for slower abilities.
